name: Bom Dia, Artisan
author: m0u
description: The daily Laravel ecosystem digest from bom-dia-artisan.dev, in the bar. A coffee mug that steams when a new edition lands; click to read every release, merge and the recommendation of the day without leaving the desktop.

barWidget.description: A mug in the bar that steams when today's Laravel digest is out and unread.

schema.label: Daily check at
schema.description: Local time (HH:MM) of the one daily check. The edition is usually out by 09:30; if not, it retries hourly until it is.

schema.label: Desktop notification
schema.description: Announce each new edition once with a toast; clicking it opens the panel.
